change_summary: Owner authorized the built-in Windows OCR reader on 2026-11-19 with the phrase 'إختياري هو إختيارك ونصيحتك لي .. أنا موافق' (choice 1: target Windows for the server) after deciding that the phone is monitoring-only; manual text input remains the phone's only document-capture path.

Added IOcrTextReader contract (raw text or explicit unavailability) in Wizz.Application and WindowsOcrTextReader in the presentation layer using Windows.Media.Ocr; Arabic language support is checked at runtime with OcrEngine.IsLanguageSupported, and missing support falls back to manual input with a clear notice.

Added OcrDocumentCaptureService: image bytes are read locally into raw text and passed to DocumentCaptureService and PerceptionAdjudicator unchanged; it never writes, never transmits, never passes through ModelRouter, and leaves route decisions and the embedded number guard untouched.

Added local image upload to the document-text adjudication card in the AI chat page, showing the extracted text and the embedded verdict with an explicit reader-unavailable state; the manual text-input path is unchanged.

Corrected the earlier negative OCR-trial record: the failure came from a UTF-8-without-BOM PowerShell script that corrupted Arabic while generating test images, not from an OCR engine. Tesseract also reads the corrected synthetic images, but is not integrated; Windows OCR stays the approved choice because it ships with the OS.

Verification: build 0 errors; tests 356/356 (24 domain + 332 integration, including 4 new synthetic-data OCR-capture tests); the shipped WindowsOcrTextReader returned '12.5 حليب 5 خبز 150 تفاح' with correct Arabic code points from a synthetic image. No real merchant data, no cloud transmission, no database writes, and no gate elevated.

Owner granted full authority for upcoming steps on 2026-11-18; execution was deliberately scoped to option A (local text-input layer) of DOCUMENT_CAPTURE_ENABLEMENT_AUTHORIZATION_REQUEST_AR.md because the other options require an external library, a verification source, or a target-framework change that are reserved decisions. Phase 6 and all NEEDS-VALIDATION gates were left unchanged.

Added DocumentCaptureService (AI/Perception) with DocumentCaptureRequest/Result: local recognized text is extracted into candidates by PerceptionCandidateExtractor and adjudicated by PerceptionAdjudicator against active store product prices read through IProductRepository; it never writes, never transmits, and does not pass through ModelRouter, so RouteScorer decisions and number adjudication are unaffected.

Added a separate document-text adjudication card to the AI chat page showing accepted/rejected candidates with reasons and the fixed no-automatic-write notice; its state is independent of chat routing. Registered the service as scoped and added six synthetic-data integration tests.

Verification: build 0 errors; tests 352/352 (24 domain + 328 integration, including 6 new synthetic tests). No external library, no target-framework change, no cloud keys enabled, no real merchant database, no stored business data touched.

Owner authorized and executed roadmap phases 2 to 5 of the AI assistant with a single consolidated authorization ('وافقت على التفويض الموحّد بالخيارات الموصى بها', choices [1:A][2:A][3:A][4:A]): consolidated execution; build cloud sharing with both toggles disabled and no transmission; no external libraries; NEEDS-VALIDATION gates left open.

Phase 2 work modes: added AI/Orchestration (WorkMode, WorkModeResolver, FactPackage, NumberAdjudicator) over the existing router without changing RouteScorer decisions; the built-in permanently adjudicates every final number against a fact package; work-mode and adjudication transparency added to route results and the chat UI; manual route choice retained; no database writes.

Phase 3 safe cloud sharing: added AI/Privacy (ApprovedPrivacyWording, RedactionValidator, QuestionRedactor, CloudShareGuard, CloudPromptGuard). CloudSharingEnabled is a separate toggle from the cloud model, both default false; no request is prepared or sent unless both are on and mandatory redaction has run; only a redacted anonymous summary is used, with no store context; the exact approved privacy wording is shown in settings; a final independent pre-HTTP guard was added in CloudLlmProvider. Nothing was actually sent.

Phase 4 perception: added AI/Perception (PerceptionCandidate, PerceptionCandidateExtractor, PerceptionAdjudicator) using only standard .NET; perception results remain candidates until the built-in adjudicates them against known products; WrittenToDatabase stays false.

Phase 5 semantic: added AI/Semantic (SemanticIntent, SemanticIntentResolver, SemanticMemory) for local intent understanding and follow-up reference resolution, with a short local conversation memory; no stored business data touched and nothing sent externally; shared-core dialect quality remains NEEDS-VALIDATION.

Verification: build 0 errors; tests 346/346 (24 domain + 322 integration, including 33 new synthetic-data phases 2-5 tests); three paths and manual choice retained; no cloud key enabled; no real merchant database queried and no real-device restore claimed.
